results.primary_cause: Exact current external evidence for specialty DRAM, NOR, or NAND pricing and utilization was not found; no verifiable support or counter source was available after the required searches.
Exact current external evidence for commodity DRAM ASP, bit demand, and inventory was not found; HBM-related or price-only evidence cannot establish this driver.
No verifiable current source confirming or contradicting a memory IC design-demand and ASP cycle was found; available search results did not establish the exact driver.

Evidence supports evolving SSD and NAND-controller demand, but does not establish a current industry-wide NAND pricing, controller/module demand, and inventory cycle; pricing and inventory evidence remains insufficient.

supporting_evidence.claim: Phison, a NAND flash controller supplier, described data growth and SSD adoption as reshaping storage demand across consumer devices and data centers, providing company-specific evidence of controller and SSD demand.
supporting_evidence.source_title: Phison Electronics Corp highlights its NAND controller role as demand for storage keeps evolving

results.primary_cause: Evidence indicates stronger Capesize-related freight conditions, but counter-evidence indicates that apparent 2026 strength may be substantially caused by forced rerouting and could reverse into a supply glut; the underlying broad commodity-volume freight cycle is unresolved.

supporting_evidence.claim: Reporting citing Bloomberg stated that rising Capesize vessel demand and tightening ship supply drove a key dry-bulk freight measure to its highest level since December 2023.
supporting_evidence.source_title: Dry-Bulk Shipping Rates Hit Two-Year High on Capesize Demand

counter_evidence.claim: BIMCO warned that apparent 2026 dry-bulk market strength was substantially artificial, driven by forced rerouting, and that the effect could reverse into a 2027 supply glut.
counter_evidence.source_title: Dry bulk shipping faces 2027 supply glut: BIMCO warns Hormuz rerouting boost will reverse
